title: catunaregam obovata
intro: Catunaregam obovata, commonly known as the Elephant Creeper, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The health benefits of Catunaregam obovata include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and as an antiseptic agent to prevent infection. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Catunaregam obovata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
